text: Northstar Bank employee KYC onboarding policy. Verify customer identity using one government-issued photo ID and one address proof before account activation. Record verification outcome in the KYC case system. When either document is missing, pause onboarding and create a verification task for the operations team. Never approve an exception without a recorded reviewer.

Northstar Bank AML investigation workflow. A suspicious transaction alert must be triaged by the compliance operations queue within four business hours. Analysts preserve the alert ID, supporting transaction evidence and review notes. Escalations go to the AML duty officer. Any required external statutory filing is determined separately by the designated legal compliance function; this teaching document does not define legal filing deadlines.

Northstar Bank sanctions screening internal procedure. A potential sanctioned-name match must be held for secondary screening and analyst review before processing. Do not release or block a transfer solely because of fuzzy-name similarity. Record the screening decision, identity evidence, analyst ID and case reference in the audit log.

Northstar Bank credit risk policy. Loan requests exceeding the automated risk limit require an independent second-level risk approval before disbursement. The reviewer documents the override reason, score band, collateral evidence and approval ticket. The originating sales representative cannot approve their own override.

Northstar Bank internal security incident procedure. Report a suspected account compromise using the security incident portal immediately. Do not email credentials, customer identity documents or one-time passcodes. A priority-one incident is escalated to the security operations on-call team and preserved for audit.

Northstar Bank model risk governance. A credit scoring model material update must pass validation by an independent model risk reviewer before a production rollout. Keep model version, test evidence, drift checks, feature lineage and change approvals in the model inventory. A failed validation blocks deployment.

Northstar Bank privacy operations procedure. Employees must not paste customer PII into public chat tools. Requests for customer data export must pass verified identity checks, documented approval and least-privilege delivery. Retention and deletion decisions are referred to the legal privacy team; no universal statutory retention interval is asserted here.

Archived Northstar Bank KYC onboarding policy. Under the superseded 2024 process, onboarding could proceed with only a government ID while address proof arrived later. THIS RULE EXPIRED ON 2025-12-31 and must not be used for current decisions.

Harbor Finance internal KYC policy. Harbor Finance employees validate customer identity through the Harbor Identity Desk, submit a HarborCase ticket and archive a verification checklist. These steps are not part of Northstar Bank procedures.
